items.q: and do solos, like at the different churches, and you know -- things like that -- she would accompany me.

ctx.x: In fact, we became so close that when I would go out
and do solos, like at the different churches, and you know -- things like that -- she would accompany me. She was also a piano player.
She would go along and accompany me.
